description: This file defines a composable UI component for the PostOnboardingTabs screen in an Android app, including tab navigation, status bar, and associated UI logic using Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: Enum class representing different tabs in the home screen: Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: Enum class to represent different visual statuses of the connection: Connected, Connecting, Warning, Error, Offline.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the tab interface, managing state, and handling navigation and status display.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Composable for rendering the Screen tab content, including connection refresh logic.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Displays the top status bar with connection status text and visual indicator.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Creates the bottom navigation bar with tab icons and labels.
